name: aa.com
body: Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 12 scripts block the first paint.
lesson: Add defer to every script the first paint does not need.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 18 of 18 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.aa.com scores 81 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 24 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 12 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 8 script hosts are loaded without integrity checks
fix.evidence: cdn.quantummetric.com, www.everestjs.net, tags.tiqcdn.com, cdn.aa.com and 4 more. If that CDN is compromised, its code runs on the site.
fix.fix: Add integrity="sha384-…" and crossorigin="anonymous" to fixed-version CDN scripts.

works.title: Every external link that was checked answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 60 ms
Every page has a meta description
